datasets.name: a0f313f2
queryLines:
SELECT
    c.state AS state,
    o.currency AS currency,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    ROUND(SUM(o.order_total), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(o.order_total), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM workspace.ecommerce_silver.silver_customers c
INNER JOIN workspace.ecommerce_silver.silver_orders o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE
    c.state IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(c.state) != ''
    AND UPPER(o.order_status) != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY
    c.state,
    o.currency
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC;

datasets.name: 19f0a801
queryLines:
WITH shipment_data AS (
    SELECT
        s.shipment_id,
        s.order_id,
        s.shipment_status,
        c.state AS destination_state
    FROM workspace.ecommerce_silver.silver_shipments s
    INNER JOIN workspace.ecommerce_silver.silver_orders o
        ON s.order_id = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN workspace.ecommerce_silver.silver_customers c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),

state_coordinates AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM VALUES
        ('Tamil Nadu', 11.1271, 78.6569),
        ('Maharashtra', 19.7515, 75.7139),
        ('Delhi', 28.7041, 77.1025),
        ('Telangana', 18.1124, 79.0193),
        ('Karnataka', 15.3173, 75.7139),
        ('Kerala', 10.8505, 76.2711),
        ('Rajasthan', 27.0238, 74.2179),
        ('West Bengal', 22.9868, 87.8550)
    AS t(state, latitude, longitude)
)

SELECT
    sd.shipment_id,
    sd.order_id,
    sd.shipment_status,
    'Chennai' AS origin_city,
    sd.destination_state AS destination_city,
    13.0827 AS origin_latitude,
    80.2707 AS origin_longitude,
    sc.latitude AS destination_latitude,
    sc.longitude AS destination_longitude,
    ST_GEOMFROMTEXT(
        CONCAT(
            'LINESTRING(80.2707 13.0827, ',
            CAST(sc.longitude AS STRING), ' ',
            CAST(sc.latitude AS STRING),
            ')'
        )
    ) AS route_geometry
FROM shipment_data sd
INNER JOIN state_coordinates sc
    ON LOWER(TRIM(sd.destination_state)) = LOWER(TRIM(sc.state));

datasets.name: d8b5867e
queryLines:
SELECT
    order_value_range,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_frequency
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN order_total < 500 THEN '0 - 499'
            WHEN order_total < 1000 THEN '500 - 999'
            WHEN order_total < 2000 THEN '1000 - 1999'
            WHEN order_total < 5000 THEN '2000 - 4999'
            WHEN order_total < 10000 THEN '5000 - 9999'
            ELSE '10000+'
        END AS order_value_range
    FROM workspace.ecommerce_silver.silver_orders
    WHERE order_total IS NOT NULL
      AND order_total >= 0
) t
GROUP BY order_value_range;

datasets.name: 1f1ac455
queryLines:
WITH reconciliation AS (

    SELECT
        currency,

        SUM(order_total) AS gross_order_value,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(order_status) = 'CANCELLED'
                THEN order_total
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS cancelled_order_value,

        SUM(refunded_amount) AS total_refunds,

        SUM(net_payment_amount) AS net_collected_payment

    FROM workspace.ecommerce_gold.gold_order_payment_summary

    GROUP BY currency
),

waterfall_values AS (

    SELECT
        currency,
        gross_order_value,
        cancelled_order_value,
        total_refunds,
        net_collected_payment,

        net_collected_payment -
        (
            gross_order_value
            - cancelled_order_value
            - total_refunds
        ) AS payment_collection_difference

    FROM reconciliation
)

SELECT
    currency,
    1 AS stage_order,
    'Gross Order Value' AS reconciliation_stage,
    gross_order_value AS amount,
    'TOTAL' AS stage_type,
    gross_order_value

FROM waterfall_values

UNION ALL

SELECT
    currency,
    2,
    'Less Cancelled Order Value',
    -cancelled_order_value,
    'CHANGE',
    gross_order_value

FROM waterfall_values

UNION ALL

SELECT
    currency,
    3,
    'Less Refunds',
    -total_refunds,
    'CHANGE',
    gross_order_value - cancelled_order_value

FROM waterfall_values

UNION ALL

SELECT
    currency,
    4,
    'Payment Collection Difference',
    payment_collection_difference,
    'CHANGE',
    gross_order_value - cancelled_order_value - total_refunds

FROM waterfall_values

UNION ALL

SELECT
    currency,
    5,
    'Net Collected Payment',
    net_collected_payment,
    'TOTAL',
    net_collected_payment

FROM waterfall_values

ORDER BY currency, stage_order;
